Disney Magical World.name: Disney Magical World
Disney Magical World.summary: Disney Magical World features dozens of Disney characters in a variety of Disney-themed worlds. Players can customize their characters with hundreds of Disney-themed outfits and accessories, all while managing a café, planting crops and collecting Disney character cards. Players help different characters solve problems or find missing items.

Games Festival 1.name: Games Festival Volume 1
Games Festival 1.summary: Hear ye! Hear ye! Hear ye! Gather round and join in the fun of the fair! Amusements for one and all, dart and balloon games, games of skill, and even the famous hook-a-duck! On your own or with your friends, the only thing missing is candyfloss!

Kobayashi ga Kawai Sugite Tsurai!! Game.name: Kobayashi ga Kawai Sugite Tsurai!! Game Demo Kyun Moe Max ga Tomaranai
Kobayashi ga Kawai Sugite Tsurai!! Game.summary: Kobayashi ga Kawai Sugite Tsurai!! Game demo Kyun Moe Max ga Tomaranai~ is a game based off the anime.

Mysterious Cities of Gold, The - Secret.name: The Mysterious Cities of Gold: Secret Paths
Mysterious Cities of Gold, The - Secret.summary: Play Esteban, Zia and Tao through numerous tricky levels full of puzzles, traps and infiltration phases in a wide variety of diverse gorgeous settings. Explore every nook and cranny of China, and escape Zarès' hostile men, searching for the local City of Gold.

Reel Fishing Paradise 3D.name: Reel Fishing Paradise 3D
Reel Fishing Paradise 3D.summary: Travel to over a dozen stunning fishing locales in your quest to become a master angler. Fish in tranquil lakes, rocky coastal waters, flooded forests, and more, all rendered in eye-popping 3D that brings every leaping fish and splash of water to life. A huge variety of fish will test the expertise of even the most seasoned fishing veterans, from wily largemouth bass to powerful bluefin tuna. Mix-and-match rods, reels, lines, lures or bait to create your own personalized tackle box. Collecting rare items is both advantageous and addictive, with tons of gear to discover and use. With so much to see and do, Reel Fishing Paradise 3D is a game guaranteed to draw you into its depths!

Sega 3D Fukkoku Archives 3 - Final Stage.name: Sega 3D Fukkoku Archives 3: Final Stage
Sega 3D Fukkoku Archives 3 - Final Stage.summary: Sega 3D Fukkoku Archives 3: Final Stage is a compilation for the Nintendo 3DS and the last game of the Sega 3D Fukkoku Archives series. This compilation includes the remaining five previously-released 3D Classics games, as well as four brand new games and two unlockable SG-1000 games given stereoscopic 3D support.

Word Wizard 3D.name: Word Wizard 3D
Word Wizard 3D.summary: Classic word games that are addictive and absorbing with endless fun gameplay
